ケバブ屋
観客

Entry.EnglishText: %s

Entry.JapaneseText: へい！ らっしゃいッ!! おいしい焼きソバはどうだい！
Entry.EnglishText: Heya, welcome! How 'bout some tasty yakisoba bread?

Entry.JapaneseText: 焼きソバと言っても ソースでも塩でもねぇ
Entry.EnglishText: Even though we call it “yakisoba,” there's no sauce or salt.

Entry.JapaneseText: ユーライオ闘技場名物 マヨネーズ焼きソバだ!!
Entry.EnglishText: This is Couraleo's famous mayo yakisoba!

Entry.JapaneseText: 観戦のお供には ケバブよりマヨ焼きソバだよ!!
Entry.EnglishText: A great snack to eat while watching a round! Way better than a kebab!

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場に出場するなら 熱い試合をしてくれよ
Entry.EnglishText: If you're participating in the tournament, go and put on a good show!

Entry.JapaneseText: 試合内容がショボイと 売り上げも落ちるからねぇ！
Entry.EnglishText: If the match is boring, our sales with drop!

Entry.JapaneseText: マヨ焼きソバがさらに進化！ 明太子をトッピングした マヨ明太焼きソバだよ
Entry.EnglishText: Mayo yakisoba has reached a whole new level! Now with a mentaiko topping!

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場は今日も熱戦の連続！
Entry.EnglishText: Your fight today was insane!

Entry.JapaneseText: おかげで新しい焼きソバの 売り上げも上々さぁ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Thanks to you, our sales have gone through the roof!

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ、さぁ、いらっしゃい！ 大好評、新発売の カレー明太マヨ焼きソバだよぉ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, come on in! Try out hit new curry mentaiko yakisoba bun!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……母ちゃんのケバブが 美味いのはわかってる……
Entry.EnglishText: ...I know that mom's kebabs are delicious...

Entry.JapaneseText: 美味いからこそ 俺は母ちゃんの味を超えたいんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: It's BECAUSE they're so tasty that I want to surpass it!

Entry.JapaneseText: この闘技場は、俺と母ちゃんの 味バトルの会場でもあるのさ！ 俺は、この最終進化メニュー……
Entry.EnglishText: This arena is also the stage for our culinary battle! And now, my recipe has finally reached its final form...

Entry.JapaneseText: カレー明太マヨ焼きソバ ＩＮパイナップルで勝負をかける!!
Entry.EnglishText: Behold, my curry mentai yakisoba bread IN A PINEAPPLE!!!

Entry.JapaneseText: お客さん、ケバブはいかが？ よ〜く焼き上げた羊肉をサラダと 一緒にパンにはさんだ料理だよ
Entry.EnglishText: Wanna try a kebab? It's perfectly grilled lamb sandwiched in a flatbread with fresh salad.

Entry.JapaneseText: ヘルシーでオシャレで美味しくて 観戦のお供にはもってこいだよ
Entry.EnglishText: It's healthy, stylish and delicious all in one! A perfect treat for enjoying while watching a round.

Entry.JapaneseText: ケバブに比べたら マヨ焼きソバなんて 下品なお子ちゃま料理さ
Entry.EnglishText: Compared to my kebabs, those mayo yakisoba buns are filthy junk food.

Entry.JapaneseText: ウチのケバブは超厚切り肉だよ！ 闘技場を勝ち抜く力がつくよぉ!!
Entry.EnglishText: We slice our meat nice and thick! Enough to give you the strength to take on the arena!

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁさぁ、こんがり焼きたての ケバブはいかが？
Entry.EnglishText: So, how about some freshly roasted kebab?

Entry.JapaneseText: 悪趣味な焼きソバを食べてる 場合じゃないよぉー！
Entry.EnglishText: Now's no time for eating greasy, tasteless noodles!

Entry.JapaneseText: 熱戦と一緒に アツアツのケバブをどうぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: Enjoy a kebab as piping hot as the battles of the arena!

Entry.JapaneseText: 実は、となりの焼きソバ屋は あたしの息子なんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: The yakisoba bun stall over there is actually run by my son, you see.

Entry.JapaneseText: 『自分の味で勝負したい』と言って ケバブ屋を継いでくれないんだ。 母親の味がキライなのかね……
Entry.EnglishText: He refused to take over the kebab Store, saying “I challenge you to a culinary showdown!” or something. Maybe he just hates his mother's cooking...

Entry.JapaneseText: おっとごめんよ！ さみしい話をしちゃったね
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, pardon me! Didn't mean to bring up such a gloomy subject.

Entry.JapaneseText: 息子は息子なりに あたしを想ってくれてるんだねぇ けどさ……
Entry.EnglishText: I know my son cares about me in his own way...

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界の行く末より あたしゃ息子の暴走が心配だよ！ こうなりゃ味勝負上等!!
Entry.EnglishText: Forget the world, I'm more worries about my son going off the rails! If you want a showdown, you've got one!

Entry.JapaneseText: 叩きのめしてイチから 料理を教えてやらなきゃ！ まったく世話が焼ける息子だよぉ
Entry.EnglishText: I'll just have to beat you, then teach you how to cook again from square one! What a handful, that boy of mine.

Entry.JapaneseText: ううぅ…… 世界最高の勇者は誰なんだッ!?
Entry.EnglishText: Ooh... Who's gonna be awarded world champion?!

Entry.JapaneseText: くそぉ…… わしもライオグランプリに 参加すべきだったぁぁーーーッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Dammit... I should have entered the Grand Prix too!

Entry.JapaneseText: 苦悩、葛藤、挫折、後悔…… 闘技場には人生の全てがある
Entry.EnglishText: Anguish, conflict, failure, regret... Every facet of life is reflected in this arena.

Entry.JapaneseText: わしが乗り越えてきた全てが!!
Entry.EnglishText: I have triumphed over it all!

Entry.JapaneseText: きみたちも闘技場を勝ち抜き わしのような人生の勝者を 目指しなさい
Entry.EnglishText: You should should aim for the top of the competition, then you can be a winner in life just like me!

Entry.JapaneseText: 勝利、栄光、名誉、快楽…… 闘技場には人生の全てがある
Entry.EnglishText: Victory, glory, honor, pleasure... Every facet of life is reflected in this arena.

Entry.JapaneseText: わしが勝ち取ってきた全てが!!
Entry.EnglishText: I have won it all!

Entry.JapaneseText: きみたちも闘技場を勝ち抜き わしのような人生の勝者を 目指しなさい
Entry.EnglishText: You should should aim for the top of the competition, then you can be a winner in life just like me!

Entry.JapaneseText: 人生は山あり谷あり…… 勝つ時もあれば負ける時もある。 だが、わしは…………
Entry.EnglishText: Life has highs and lows... sometimes you win, and others you lose. I however...

Entry.JapaneseText: 最後には必ず勝利する！ なぜなら、わしは勝つまで あきらめないからだ!!
Entry.EnglishText: I'll be sure to win in the end! I won't give up until victory is mine!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ん？ 単にシツコイ性格なだけ？ ……そうとも言うな
Entry.EnglishText: ...Hm? That's just being stubborn? You don't have to put it like that...

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ、私も参加したい！
Entry.EnglishText: I want to participate, too!

Entry.JapaneseText: 選ばれしセレブとして 世界勇者のセレブリティを 手に入れたい!!
Entry.EnglishText: As a selected celebrity, I want to go down in the book as the bravest celebrity in the world!

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界勇者のセレブリティを 手に入れたいザマス〜〜〜!!
Entry.EnglishText: I want to be known as the bravest celebrity in the world, man!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……あら、やだ！ 『ザマス』なんてニセセレブ言葉を 使ってしまったわ……
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, pardon me! “Man” isn't fitting of a celebrity...

Entry.JapaneseText: いけ〜〜〜っ！ いくザマ〜〜〜スっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Eyy! C'mon, ya punk!

Entry.JapaneseText: はっ!? また『ザマス』って 言っちゃったわね……
Entry.EnglishText: Ah! Once again, that wasn't very proper of me.

Entry.JapaneseText: 私はニセセレブじゃないザマ…… ……ないですよ？
Entry.EnglishText: I swear, I'm a proper celebrity! PROPER!

Entry.JapaneseText: いけ〜〜〜っ！ いくザ〜〜〜ンスっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Eyy! C'mon, ya punk!

Entry.JapaneseText: はっ！ 今度は『ザンス』って 言っちゃった!?
Entry.EnglishText: My! I said it again!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ちなみに私の名前は スーザンですけど
Entry.EnglishText: ...Just so you know, my name is Susan.

Entry.JapaneseText: どっちも負けるなでガンス〜!!
Entry.EnglishText: I won't lose to either of you blockheads!

Entry.JapaneseText: え!? 今、私『ガンス』って言った!?
Entry.EnglishText: Oh! I've done it once again!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……疲れてるでゴンスね……
Entry.EnglishText: ...I'm exhausted of this.

Entry.JapaneseText: くぅぅ……ワシが もう少し若ければ……
Entry.EnglishText: Ooh, if only I had a year or two taken off me.

Entry.JapaneseText: ワシが、もう五年若ければ 参加するんじゃがのぅ！
Entry.EnglishText: If only I were five years younger, I'd be out there in the arena!

Entry.JapaneseText: 血が騒ぐ……ワシも もう少し若ければ……
Entry.EnglishText: This really gets your blood pumping... Ah, if only I were younger...

Entry.JapaneseText: ワシも、もう三年若ければ 参戦するんじゃがのぅ！
Entry.EnglishText: If I were only three years younger I'd be out there fighting in the war!

Entry.JapaneseText: うおぉーーー！ ワシは、もうガマンできんッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Argh! I can't take it anymore!

Entry.JapaneseText: 今から体をきたえて 一年後には参戦してみせる！
Entry.EnglishText: I'll start training now, and by next year I'll be ready!

Entry.JapaneseText: 待っておれよぉぉーーーッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: You just wait and see!

Entry.JapaneseText: 体力には限界があるが スピリアには限界はない！
Entry.EnglishText: Though my body may have its limits, my Spiria knows no bounds!

Entry.JapaneseText: よし、ワシもソーマを手に入れて 闘技場に出るぞぃ！
Entry.EnglishText: Alright, all I gotta do is get my hands on a Soma then I'll be tearing up the arena in no time!

Entry.JapaneseText: よし、ワシもソーマを手に入れて 闘技場に出るぞぃ！ あんたの ソーマを譲ってくれんかね？
Entry.EnglishText: Alright, all I gotta do is get my hands on a Soma! You there, willing to part with yours?

Entry.JapaneseText: やるぜぇぇぇ…… 勇者の証を手に入れるのは 俺だぁぁーーーッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: I'm gonna do it... The one taking home the title is ME!

Entry.JapaneseText: うおお、俺はやるッ！ やってやるぜぇッッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Woohoo, let's freakin' GO! YEAH YEAH YEAH!!!

Entry.JapaneseText: 前世界勇者アーメスは 出場しねぇのかな？
Entry.EnglishText: Think the previous world champ Ameth will be entering again this year?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……出場してるヒマはないか？ アーメスは飛空船の維持費で 苦しんでるらしいからな……
Entry.EnglishText: ...You think he's got the time? Looks like he's really scraping by trying to repair his airship...

Entry.JapaneseText: なぁ、世界は どうなっちまうと思う？
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, what do you think's gonna happen to the world?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……てか、次の勝負は どっちに賭けたらいいと思う？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Which outcome should I be betting on?

Entry.JapaneseText: もう悩むのはやめだ！
Entry.EnglishText: No, enough worrying!

Entry.JapaneseText: 俺は、俺が信じた方に賭けるぜ！
Entry.EnglishText: I'll bet on the one I believe in!

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界は滅びないッ！ ……………………多分!!
Entry.EnglishText: This world will not fall! Well... hopefully!

Entry.JapaneseText: やってやるわ！ 乙女の勇気を見せつけてやるわよっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: I'm gonna do it! I'll show you the courage of a lady!

Entry.JapaneseText: 乙女なめんなよ、ごらぁっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Don't underestimate me just 'cause I'm a girl!

Entry.JapaneseText: 戦士たちに届け、乙女の祈り……
Entry.EnglishText: May this lady's wish reach those warriors...

Entry.JapaneseText: 呪……呪……呪……呪…… 戦士のお腹よ、痛くなぁれ……
Entry.EnglishText: Curse them... Give them all an upset stomach...

Entry.JapaneseText: くくく…… 我が祈りで弱まれ戦士ども。 奴らを倒すのは、わたしなのだ
Entry.EnglishText: Hehehe... Be weakened by my curse, then I'LL be the one to come out victorious!

Entry.JapaneseText: 熱戦に注目しすぎて 目からなんか出ちゃいそう……
Entry.EnglishText: I was so glued to that intense match I feel something welling in my eyes!

Entry.JapaneseText: くらえ、乙女の熱視線！ 乙女ビィーーーーームッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Eat this, the passionate gaze of a lady! LADY BEEEAM!!!

Entry.JapaneseText: あなたに届け、乙女の祈り……
Entry.EnglishText: May this lady's wish reach you...

Entry.JapaneseText: 乙女の未来を頼むぞ、ごらぁっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: A lady's plea for our future!!

Entry.JapaneseText: ひひひ、今こそ最強最悪の オバちゃんパワー…… 『オバパワー』の出番だよ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Hehehe... get ready for grandma's secret move... the “Gran Slam!”

Entry.JapaneseText: 賞金１億ガルドで このユーライオに豪邸を建て セレブデビューしてやるよぉっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: I'm gonna win that hundred million gald prize, build a mansion here in Couraleo and make my debut among the rich and famous!

Entry.JapaneseText: うおぉぉ、たかまれ！ あたしのオバパワーよぉぉっ！！！
Entry.EnglishText: Whoooa, the power's flowing through me! Get ready for a GRAN SLAM!!!

Entry.JapaneseText: いけぇー、やっちまぇーっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Take this, and that!

Entry.JapaneseText: やっちまいな！ あたしが亭主をシバくみたいにっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: That's all wrong! Do it you're whacking your dumb old husband!

Entry.JapaneseText: いけぇー、くらわせろぉーっ
Entry.EnglishText: Take this, aaargh!

Entry.JapaneseText: 精神的にもけずれ！ あたしが亭主をいたぶるようにっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: No no, you mindset's all wrong! Do it like you're tearing strips off your dumb old husband!

Entry.JapaneseText: あんたらに あたしの力を託すよ……
Entry.EnglishText: I entrust my powers to you...

Entry.JapaneseText: あたしのオバパワーを あんたらに全部託すよ！
Entry.EnglishText: All of my Grand Power is yours to keep!

Entry.JapaneseText: オバパワーで世界を救っとくれ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Go, save the world with GRAND POWER!!!

Entry.JapaneseText: うおぉぉ、これがウワサの ライオグランプリかっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Whoooa, so this is the illustrious Couraleo Grand Prix!

Entry.JapaneseText: こんなにスピリアが ふるえたのは、はじめてだよっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: I've never felt my Spiria tremble so much in my whole life!

Entry.JapaneseText: そこだ！ いけぇぇ〜ッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Yeah! Finish him!

Entry.JapaneseText: いやぁ〜、闘技場はハマるねぇ♪
Entry.EnglishText: Oh man, it's so easy to lose yourself watching a match! ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: 彼女を連れて 毎日かよっちゃうほどだよ!!
Entry.EnglishText: I take my girlfriend to go watch every day!

Entry.JapaneseText: いやぁ、面白い試合が続くなぁ！
Entry.EnglishText: Ooh, what a nail biter, that one!

Entry.JapaneseText: 最近は、オレより彼女の方が 闘技場にハマっちゃってるんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: Lately, she's been even more into the arena than I am.

Entry.JapaneseText: 行けぇ！ 今こそスピリアの 強さを見せてくれっっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Get out there! Show us what your Spiria's really made of!

Entry.JapaneseText: ははは、こんな状況になっても 楽しむ事をやめられないんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Haha, even in times like this I can't help but have a good time!

Entry.JapaneseText: こんな無神経さも 人間のスピリアの強さの ひとつなのかもなぁ？
Entry.EnglishText: Maybe that kinda insensitive attitude is just another power of man's Spiria?

Entry.JapaneseText: ドキドキ……
Entry.EnglishText: My heart's racing...

Entry.JapaneseText: ドキドキがとまらないわ！
Entry.EnglishText: My heart just won't stop!

Entry.JapaneseText: ドキン！ ドキン！
Entry.EnglishText: Aaah!

Entry.JapaneseText: もう、心臓がバクバクよ!!
Entry.EnglishText: My heart's about to pound right outta my chest!

Entry.JapaneseText: 熱い！ 熱ーーーいっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Hot! Hothothot!!!

Entry.JapaneseText: スピリアも体もあつすぎなのっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Both my body and Spiria are burning up!

Entry.JapaneseText: ドキドキドキドキ……
Entry.EnglishText: Squee...

Entry.JapaneseText: もう……このドキドキは カレがとなりにいるからなのに カレってば全然気付いてくれないの
Entry.EnglishText: Geez... I'm losing it because my boyfriend's sitting so close to me, but he doesn't notice at all!

Entry.JapaneseText: ホント、無神経なんだからっ！
Entry.EnglishText: How dense can you be?!
